QuestionStmt.S: An element $\Delta l = \Delta x \hat{i}$ is placed at the origin and carries a current of 10 A. The magnitude of magnetic field on the Y axis at a distance of 0.5 m if $\Delta x = 1$ cm is $\left(\frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} = 10^{-7} \text{ SI unit}\right) (\sin 90^\circ = 1)$

Solution.S:
Given: $\Delta l = \Delta x \hat{i} = 0.01$ m, $I = 10$ A, $r = 0.5$ m, $\frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} = 10^{-7}$.

Using Biot-Savart law: $dB = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{I \Delta l \sin \theta}{r^2}$.

Here $\theta = 90^\circ$ (since $\Delta l$ is along x-axis and point is on y-axis), so $\sin 90^\circ = 1$.

$$dB = 10^{-7} \times \frac{10 \times 0.01}{(0.5)^2} = 10^{-7} \times \frac{0.1}{0.25} = 10^{-7} \times 0.4 = 4 \times 10^{-8} \text{ T}$$

Thus the correct option is C: $4 \times 10^{-8}$ T.
